candidates.title: Format a restaurant order alert

demandEvidence.chore: A proposed test takes an order event and prepares an operator-reviewed notification for a restaurant.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I want to build an automated restaurant order notification system using Make.com .

ease.reason: A beginner could mock an order event and format an alert, but no supplied reference documents the trigger or WhatsApp delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: a restaurant might pay for timely order alerts; this request establishes neither willingness to pay nor payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can format synthetic orders; website access, event triggering and WhatsApp delivery remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed loop could format each supplied event, but trigger and delivery are unsupported and a person should verify alerts.

evidence.reason: The discussion explicitly requests an automated restaurant order notification system, but gives no fields, frequency or working implementation.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: the request supports a narrow mock alert, but there is no implementation evidence for the website trigger or WhatsApp delivery.

candidates.title: Prepare an event email notification

demandEvidence.chore: A proposed test turns an operator-supplied event into a reviewed email notification draft.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: I’m building an n8n workflow that sends an email notification when a specific event occurs.

ease.reason: A beginner can test a supplied event and draft an email, but no attached reference documents SMTP setup or delivery.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: independent service operators may pay for event alerts; this post establishes no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can format one sample event as a draft; SMTP connection and reliable delivery remain unverified.

autonomy.reason: A proposed workflow can prepare a notification from a supplied event, but sending needs configuration and human verification.

evidence.reason: The post explicitly describes an email notification on a specific event, but gives no event details, frequency or implementation reference.

candidates.reason: Below threshold: an event-to-email draft is a bounded experiment, but SMTP capability and a specific recurring professional-services chore are not established.
